name: Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)
description: During the Clone Wars, this IG-86 sentinel droid worked as an assassin droid. Built by Holowan Mechanicals, it was recruited in Cad Bane's posse when the bounty hunter was hired to free Ziro Desilijic Tiure from a prison. To accomplish this, Bane planned to take a group of senators as a hostages, and exchange them for Ziro.
